name: Racecadotril
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 mg once, then 100 mg three times daily before main meals; stop after two normal stools; maximum 7 days

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors; to a lesser extent ARBs, mTOR inhibitors, gliptins, sacubitril, estramustine, alteplase

serious: DRESS, erythema multiforme, toxic skin eruption

pk.bioavailability: Not changed by food (peak effect delayed about 1.5 hours)
pk.half_life: About 3 hours (enzyme inhibition; lasts about 8 hours)

sources.citation: Bioproject Europe Ltd. (2025). Hidrasec 100 mg hard capsules (racecadotril) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA1714/001/001; text revised May 2025]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
